reason: This changes SQL-visible DML execution semantics for partition-table UPDATEs in core table/index code, not just a local refactor. Reordering update operators around partition movement and global indexes can introduce high-severity correctness bugs such as wrong-row updates, duplicate/unique-check mishandling, or index/data inconsistency. Even with only two code paths touched, the affected paths are central to partitioned-table runtime behavior and deserve deeper review.
